acceptance_checks: REVIEWER_ADAPTER.exec_argv includes --output-format json; parse_code_review_verdict returns the verdict from a result envelope's structured_output and fails closed on non-success subtype or prose-only result.
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests passes (incl. the new regression tests) and python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py passes.
A real claude -p reviewer run with the adapter argv parses to a valid verdict via parse_code_review_verdict.
non_goals: No change to the read-only confinement contract (--tools allowlist, --disallowedTools for real mutators + mcp__*, --strict-mcp-config, --setting-sources, --permission-mode dontAsk unchanged).
No product source change outside scripts/shiki_runtime_adapters.py and its tests.
scope: Add --output-format json to REVIEWER_ADAPTER so claude -p emits the schema-validated object in the result envelope's structured_output field; rewrite parse_code_review_verdict to read structured_output (subtype-gated, fail-closed); drop the unknown deny-name MultiEdit (the --tools allowlist already bars it); add regression tests for the --output-format json contract, the structured_output envelope, subtype fail-close, and prose-without-structured-output fail-close.
title: Fix reviewer structured-output emission and parsing in the pre-PR code-review gate
